payload.name: Confession of Faith
payload.description: Eros moves to an edge of the arena and performs one of two attacks: Lightning Breath: If Eros's two side heads gain electrical orbs near their mouths, the attack resolves as a stack marker on a random player along with each of the side heads firing off a large cone attack to the sides, leaving the area directly in front of Eros safe. Fire Breath: If Eros's center head gains a fiery orb in its mouth, the attack resolves as player-targeted circle AoEs on two random players along with a large cone attack from the center head. Stand directly next to Eros's sides to avoid the attack.
